Controls

MouseLook around W A S DRun, steer in the air, climb on walls Hold left clickShoot a web and swing (helicopters work too). Let go to launch Right click or EZip to the marker, web a getaway car or a helicopter, or go through a door SpaceJump. On a wall, kick off it ShiftSprint on the ground, dive in the air FSwing without the mouse EscPause and fast travel

Run into any wall to start a wall run. Hold W to climb, A and D to run sideways, and top out over the ledge.
